content_zh:
也许是因为羞怯，这一天戴夫没有来咖啡馆，约会时甚至还迟到了两分钟，出现时他连声道歉，但却拿不出一个很好的理由解释。
珍妮简也用不着他的解释，她扫了戴夫不大合身的西装，以及明显经过反复梳理的头发一眼，就知道他为什么会迟到。——作为一个在演艺圈摸爬滚打了这些年的选角负责人，戴夫青涩得简直让她诧异。
“你选的餐馆档次已经让你不必道歉了。”她半开玩笑地说，“能预约到‘吃干抹净’，足够让你得到我的一个吻。”
‘吃干抹净’是餐厅的名字，原文为意大利语‘Scarpetta’，由名厨开设，坐落于比弗利山庄中，一顿饭可以轻松吃掉珍妮简两天的工资，如果开了好酒还要更多，作为有名气的高档餐厅，要预约一个座位并不简单，如果没有一定的关系，更难以约到靠窗边的好位置。
珍妮的夸奖显然让戴夫很高兴，他的举止自信多了，不过性格倒还是没改，并没有自己居功，而是坦白地告诉珍妮，“其实是一个好朋友为我打了电话。”
珍妮笑着说，“哇，那你的好朋友可真有本事——能交到这样的好朋友，你就更有本事了。”
她一边说一边在心里吐：这奉承得有点太明显了。
但一如她所想，对于严重缺乏自信，举止谈吐都笨拙生疏的戴夫来说，这样的态度才能让他尽快树立起信心，在珍妮连续丢出两个恭维以后，他放松得足以开玩笑了，“那么能让这么有本事的我请你吃饭，看来你才是权力链的顶端。”
珍妮立刻发出笑声，戴夫和她一起笑了起来，在一片轻松的氛围中，他们开始点餐。
珍妮已经很久没有吃过饱饭了，如果说周围的食物香味对她没有诱惑力，那是假的，但看着一套餐点中的鹅肝、甜点、酱汁，再换算一下要消耗这些卡路里必须付出的运动时间……
她点了沙拉和甜点，戴夫要得比她多，还要了一支红酒。
“你应该多吃点，即使作为想要上镜的女孩来说，你也有点太瘦了。”戴夫说，把餐前面包往珍妮眼前推了推。
“我的空余资金只允许我付这些的钱。”珍妮给自己找了个理由。
戴夫的神色发生变化，但珍妮抢在他之前开口，“我知道你想请客，不过这得是我们两人一起做的决定，不是吗？如果我觉得……我会让你请客的。”
她没有说明白，但戴夫已经红了脸，珍妮看得很奇怪，“你是不是很少外出约会？”
“上一次频繁约会的时期已经是十七年前了。”戴夫说，接下来她听了一个很常见的高中恋人走过风风雨雨，性格不合最终离婚的故事，戴夫和前妻没有小孩，前妻分到了狗。离婚后他度过三四个月的疗伤期，最近渐渐开始打算重回情场。
没什么特别的，大部分细节她都从他无名指上的戒痕猜到了，“哇，那么作为你十七年后的第一个约会，我应该感到荣幸。”
“你不是第一个约会，”戴夫说，他望着她的神色很和蔼，“但你是第一个让我觉得……非常棒的约会对象。”
“之前发生了什么事？”珍妮问，她在心里默念：和试镜的女孩出去……结果很差。
“我可能没和你说过，我是个小小的演员副导演。”戴夫说，“之前在纽约的时候，我约了几个试镜女演员出去，结果都很糟。”

Bingo，对于他一直不提自己职业的完美解释。如果不是她坚持以AA为底线，不随便接受请客，也许戴夫一直都不会说。
珍妮笑了一下，同情地说：“把生活和工作分开的人并不多见，是吗？”
戴夫哼了一声，“很多人都以为和导演睡觉就能拿到角色，但在好莱坞，事情并不是这么简单。如果你只懂得给服侍过你的人大开方便之门，那么你的副导演也就干不久了。”
有些书呆子的感觉，结婚后一直专心工作，老实人，从未受过形形色色美女的诱惑，专业性很强，并且引以为傲。
人品还不错。

content_en:
Perhaps because of shyness, Dave didn't come to the coffee shop that day, and was even two minutes late for the date. When he showed up, he apologized profusely, but couldn't come up with a good explanation.
Jenny Jane didn't need his explanation. She glanced at Dave's ill-fitting suit and his hair that had obviously been combed repeatedly, and she knew why he was late. ——As a casting director who has been in the entertainment industry for many years, Dave was so green that she was surprised.
"The quality of the restaurant you chose already means that you don't have to apologize." She said half-jokingly, "If you can make a reservation, you can get a kiss from me."
The name of the restaurant is "Scarpetta" in Italian. It was opened by a famous chef and is located in Beverly Hills. One meal can easily eat up two days of Jenny Jane's salary, and even more if you drink good wine. As a famous high-end restaurant, it is not easy to reserve a seat. If you don't have a certain relationship, it is even more difficult to get a good seat by the window.
Jenny's compliment obviously made Dave very happy. His behavior was much more confident, but his personality remained unchanged. He did not take credit for himself, but told Jenny frankly, "Actually, a good friend called for me."
Jenny smiled and said, "Wow, then your good friend is really capable - if you can make such a good friend, you will be even more capable."
As she spoke, she vomited in her mind: This flattery was a bit too obvious.
But just as she thought, for Dave who was seriously lacking in self-confidence and was clumsy and unfamiliar in his behavior and conversation, such an attitude could help him build up his confidence as quickly as possible. After Jenny threw out two compliments in a row, he was relaxed enough to joke, "Then you can let me, who is so capable, treat you to dinner. It seems that you are at the top of the power chain."
Jenny burst into laughter immediately, Dave laughed with her, and in a relaxed atmosphere they started ordering.
Jenny has not had a full meal for a long time. It would be false to say that the aroma of the food around her is not attractive to her, but looking at the foie gras, desserts, and sauces in a set meal, and then calculating the amount of exercise time that must be spent to consume these calories...
She ordered a salad and dessert, but Dave asked for more and a bottle of wine.
"You should eat more, even for a girl who wants to be on camera, you are a bit too thin." Dave said, pushing the pre-meal bread towards Jenny's eyes.
"My spare funds only allow me to pay for these." Jenny gave herself a reason.
Dave's expression changed, but Jenny spoke before him, "I know you want to treat, but this has to be a decision made by the two of us, right? If I feel... I will let you treat."
She didn’t explain clearly, but Dave was already blushing, and Jenny looked strange, “Do you rarely go out on dates?”
"The last time we dated frequently was seventeen years ago." Dave said, and then she heard a very common story about high school sweethearts who went through ups and downs, had personality differences and eventually divorced. Dave and his ex-wife had no children, and the ex-wife got a dog. After the divorce, he spent three or four months recovering, and recently he gradually began to plan to fall in love again.
There was nothing special. She guessed most of the details from the ring mark on his ring finger. "Wow, then I should feel honored to be your first date after seventeen years."
"You're not the first date," Dave said, looking at her kindly, "but you're the first date I've ever had that I thought was... great."
"What happened before?" Jenny asked, she was thinking silently in her mind: Going out with the girl who auditioned... the result was bad.
"I may not have told you, but I'm a small acting assistant director." Dave said, "When I was in New York, I dated a few audition actresses, and the results were all bad."Bingo, a perfect explanation for why he never mentioned his profession. If she hadn't insisted on taking AA as the bottom line and not accepting treats casually, maybe Dave would never have said anything.
Jenny smiled and said sympathetically: "Not many people separate life and work, right?"
Dave snorted, "Many people think that you can get a role by sleeping with a director, but in Hollywood, things are not that simple. If you only know how to open the door to people who have served you, then your assistant director will not be able to work for long."
I feel like a nerd. I have been concentrating on work since I got married. I am honest and have never been tempted by all kinds of beauties. I am very professional and proud of myself.
The character is not bad.
